newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n interest rates close unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n interest rates close unchanged.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates closed unchanged on Thursday and dealers said activity was light as banks approached the end of a reserve period.
Overnight money was quoted at a peak of 21.25 percent with most bids at 21 1/8 but the market finished at 21.00 percent, the same as on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The activity was not that strong at all as we are near the end of the reserve period," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.
"A couple of days ago there was strong liquidity on the market but now it looks more or less balanced," he added.
